description: This file defines the LeavePluginConfiguration class which implements PluginConfigurationInterface. It initializes various leave-related services and registers an event subscriber within the plugin's dependency injection container, configuring the leave management plugin for the application.

classes.name: LeavePluginConfiguration
classes.description: Implements plugin configuration for the leave management system, setting up necessary services and event subscribers.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the leave plugin by registering various leave services and adding an event subscriber.
